mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN' AND e.created_at >= #{todayStart}), 0) AS paid_card_login_today, COALESCE(SUM(e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN_FREE' AND e.created_at >= #{todayStart}), 0) AS free_login_today, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN' AND e.ref_id > 0 AND e.created_at >= #{todayStart} THEN CONCAT(e.app_id, ':', e.ref_id) END) AS active_card_today, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN_FREE' AND e.created_at >= #{todayStart} THEN e.device_hash END) AS active_visitor_today, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.created_at >= #{todayStart} THEN e.device_hash END) AS active_device_today, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN' AND e.ref_id > 0 THEN CONCAT(e.app_id, ':', e.ref_id) END) AS active_card7d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN_FREE' THEN e.device_hash END) AS active_visitor7d, COUNT(DISTINCT e.device_hash) AS active_device7d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN' AND e.ref_id > 0 AND e.created_at >= #{recentCutoff} THEN CONCAT(e.app_id, ':', e.ref_id) END) AS recent_card_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN_FREE' AND e.created_at >= #{recentCutoff} THEN e.device_hash END) AS recent_visitor_count, COALESCE(SUM(e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN_FREE' AND e.device_hash IS NULL), 0) AS unidentified_free_login7d FROM access_event e WHERE AND AND e.created_at >= #{start7d} AND e.created_at < #{end}

SELECT e.id, e.app_id, a.app_name AS app_name, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN' THEN 'CARD' ELSE 'VISITOR' END AS identity_type, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN' AND e.ref_id > 0 THEN CONCAT('card_', e.ref_id) WHEN e.event_type = 'CARD_LOGIN_FREE' AND e.device_hash IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('visitor_', e.device_hash) END AS identity_id, e.device_hash, e.client_ip, e.created_at FROM access_event e LEFT JOIN application a ON a.id = e.app_id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
